description: UN Earth Intelligence is an independent initiative exploring how NASA Earth observation data, AI, and emerging technologies can transform planetary information into actionable intelligence. Focused on climate resilience, Earth science, and global challenges, the project aims to bridge space technology, scientific discovery, and international decision-making.
summary: Earth Jukebox is a real-time web application that translates NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) visual frames into dynamic sound. Users explore an interactive Blue Marble globe while a scan line converts pixel color data into audio parameters such as pitch and intensity using the Web Audio API.Three curated experiences, Ocean & Water, Land & Vegetation, and Ice & Brightness, let listeners experience different aspects of Earth’s systems. Users can also upload their own EIC frames for personalized sonification.By converting sight into sound, Earth Jukebox makes complex Earth science data more accessible, engaging, and multi-sensory, directly addressing the challenge of expanding who can connect with NASA’s planetary visualizations.
details:
Earth Jukebox is an interactive sonification platform built specifically for the 2026 NASA Space Apps “Earth Jukebox” challenge.

How it works
A NASA Blue Marble / EIC frame is rendered as an interactive globe. A vertical analysis line continuously samples pixel color values. These values are mapped in real time to audio parameters (primarily frequency/pitch and amplitude) and synthesized using the browser’s Web Audio API. No pre-recorded audio is used — every sound is generated live from the image data.

Experiences

  • Ocean & Water: Emphasizes blue-channel dominance
  • Land & Vegetation: Highlights green and earth tones
  • Ice & Brightness: Responds to high-luminance regions

Users can also upload custom EIC frames.

Benefits & Impact

  • Makes Earth observation data multi-sensory and more inclusive
  • Creates an emotional, contemplative way to engage with planetary science
  • Demonstrates creative, real-time reuse of open NASA imagery
  • Runs entirely client-side for privacy and accessibility

Technologies

  • Lovable (AI-assisted development)
  • React + TypeScript
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Web Audio API
  • NASA Blue Marble / Earth Information Center imagery

Creativity
Instead of another visualization dashboard, Earth Jukebox treats the planet itself as a living instrument. The mapping of color to sound was carefully designed to feel natural and scientifically grounded while remaining artistic and inviting.
